name: User Profile Preference Vector Centroid Aggregation
description: To personalize feeds, recommendation engines compute a dynamic user preference vector by calculating the average centroid of the embeddings of products the user clicked in the last 7 days.
prompt:
To personalize feeds, recommendation engines compute a dynamic user preference vector by calculating the average centroid of the embeddings of products the user clicked in the last 7 days.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: user_id, user_preference_centroid.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Calculate element-wise centroid vector for user 42
            WITH unnested_dims AS (
                SELECT 
                    user_id,
                    item_id,
                    UNNEST(item_vector) AS val,
                    GENERATE_SUBSCRIPTS(item_vector, 1) AS dim_idx
                FROM user_clicks_vectors
            ),
            avg_dims AS (
                SELECT 
                    user_id,
                    dim_idx,
                    ROUND(AVG(val), 4) AS avg_dim_val
                FROM unnested_dims
                GROUP BY user_id, dim_idx
                ORDER BY user_id, dim_idx
            )
            SELECT 
                user_id,
                LIST(avg_dim_val)::FLOAT[3] AS user_preference_centroid
            FROM avg_dims
            GROUP BY user_id;
why_it_fails: SQL standard lacks native array averaging; unnesting arrays without proper positional indexes scrambles vector dimensions.
